- [Substack: Google Wins Antitrust Case, Is AI The Next Bubble? | The Friday Market Wrap!](https://realeismanplaybook.substack.com/p/google-wins-antitrust-case-is-ai-f92) - 2025-09-05

Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

The September 5 wrap corrects a prior statement about the Federal Reserve, predicts the Supreme Court will uphold emergency tariffs, and interprets Google remedies and Apple policy risks. It then reviews software disruption, Broadcom demand and Lululemon product weakness, ending with a conditional AI-overinvestment scenario.

The clear adverse forecast is the predicted IEEPA win: the Supreme Court later ruled the statute did not authorize those tariffs. Google gained important remedy relief but did not win the underlying case. His AI-bust discussion is explicitly a scenario he was not yet worried about, not a crash prediction.

### 001. The Fed was established by the Federal Reserve Act, correcting his earlier constitutional-amendment description.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | supporting

[Source at 1:00-1:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bKbcVgXLCpg&t=60s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The reviewed Supreme Court Cook opinion describes the statutory Federal Reserve structure. This is an explicit correction, not an unacknowledged repeated error.

Assessment test: Preserve the correction and the source-version limitation.

- [Trump v. Cook stay decision](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/25pdf/25a312_5468.pdf) (2026-06-29): The Court denied interim relief and required minimum notice and opportunity to respond. It protected the Fed for-cause framework but did not finally decide whether the alleged conduct supplied cause. Neither conviction nor indictment was made an automatic prerequisite.

### 005. Other statutory powers provide backup tariff options if IEEPA fails.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | forecast | major

[Source at 2:35-2:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bKbcVgXLCpg&t=155s) | Stance: conditional | Horizon: not stated

The administration invoked Section 122 following the defeat. This supports availability of alternatives, not equivalence in scope, duration or legality.

- [Temporary import surcharge](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/02/imposing-a-temporary-import-surcharge-to-address-fundamental-international-payments-problems/) (2026-02-20): The administration invoked Section 122 after the IEEPA decision, confirming an alternative statutory avenue without making all tariff powers unlimited.

<a id="youtube-bKbcVgXLCpg-c006"></a>
### 006. Google effectively won the search antitrust case because it avoided the severe requested remedies.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 2:49-4:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bKbcVgXLCpg&t=169s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Avoiding breakup and a blanket payment ban is meaningful remedy relief, but monopolization liability, exclusivity restrictions and data-sharing obligations remained.

Assessment test: Separate liability, requested remedies and ordered remedies.

- [Google search remedies](https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/department-justice-wins-significant-remedies-against-google) (2025-09-02): The remedies included prohibitions on exclusive distribution contracts and mandatory data and syndication access. The monopolization liability finding remained; relief from a requested breakup was not complete victory in the case.

<a id="youtube-bKbcVgXLCpg-c007"></a>
### 007. Apple tariff risk has been removed because its products are exempt.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 4:01-5:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bKbcVgXLCpg&t=241s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Product exclusions from reciprocal tariffs did not remove every other applicable tariff program. The official tariff schedule distinguishes overlapping authorities and exemptions.

Assessment test: Check product, origin and every applicable tariff authority.

- [2025 tariff requirements](https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2025-08/20250820_tariff_factsheet_0.pdf) (2025-08-20): USMCA origin rules provide exemptions from specified tariffs, while sectoral Section 232 duties and other rules must be evaluated separately.

## Framework and tools

- Separate a statutory case from partisan assumptions.
- Distinguish operating results from market expectations.
- Watch whether cheaper technology weakens established moats.
- Treat overinvestment as a conditional mechanism rather than a timed crash call.

Tools and charts discussed, not a complete visual inspection:

- Court holdings and remedies
- Software guidance
- Custom-AI orders
- Comparable sales
- Capital spending versus customer returns
